name: last30days-pp-mcp
description: Research any topic across Reddit, X, GitHub, Digg, and arXiv - last 30 days, scored by upvotes, likes, and stars.

openai_api_key.title: OPENAI_API_KEY
openai_api_key.description: OpenAI API key. Optional reasoning provider for headless query planning and reranking. Get one at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys.

xai_api_key.title: XAI_API_KEY
xai_api_key.description: xAI API key. Powers X / Twitter research via xAI's x_search tool and can serve as the reasoning provider. Get one at https://console.x.ai/.

xquik_api_key.title: XQUIK_API_KEY
xquik_api_key.description: Xquik API key. Key-based X / Twitter search backend for cookie-less hosts. Get one at https://xquik.com/.

google_api_key.title: GOOGLE_API_KEY
google_api_key.description: Google API key. Optional Gemini reasoning provider for headless query planning and reranking. Get one at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials.

gemini_api_key.title: GEMINI_API_KEY
gemini_api_key.description: Gemini API key. Same role as GOOGLE_API_KEY; set whichever name your tooling expects. Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey.

google_genai_api_key.title: GOOGLE_GENAI_API_KEY
google_genai_api_key.description: Alternative Google generative-AI API key. Same source as GEMINI_API_KEY; set whichever name your tooling expects.

github_token.title: GITHUB_TOKEN
github_token.description: GitHub personal access token. Optional; raises the GitHub API rate limit for person-mode and project-mode research. Create one at https://github.com/settings/tokens.

scrapecreators_api_key.title: SCRAPECREATORS_API_KEY
scrapecreators_api_key.description: ScrapeCreators API key. Optional Reddit search backup, used only when the free keyless Reddit path returns no items. Get one at https://scrapecreators.com/.
